title: fix(metadata-protocol): the strict draft read naming no package serves its content from the draft its version names
body:
Fixes #23715

Clause-②: yes

Dev session `session_01HTBbFnY86QT5g7BxeMo3Ub`, dispatched by `domain:engine` seat 1 (`session_01GP3comALHRcRBixS2TEnLF`), claim 6201610005. Related, not closed here: #23657 / PR #23706 (the draft save's address, `unboundItemDraftAddress`) and #23495 / PR #23654 (the three draft doors' address).

## What this does

The strict draft read that names no package (`GET /api/v1/meta/TYPE/NAME?state=draft`) now takes its **content** from the draft its **`version`** names: the draft `packagelessDraftAddress` gives the draft save, the per-item publish and the draft discard naming none. Before, the content address came from the item's ACTIVE rows (`packagelessReadAddress`), which name no package for an item never published into one, so `findServedOverlayRow` took the first draft row the store returned.

| state (no `?package=`) | content before | content after | `version` (unchanged) |
|---|---|---|---|
| no active row, drafts `[package-unbound, Q]`, Q's stored first (in-memory double) | **Q's draft** | package-unbound draft | package-unbound draft |
| no active row, drafts `[package-unbound, Q]`, unbound stored first | package-unbound | package-unbound | package-unbound |
| active rows bound to two packages, drafts `[package-unbound, P]`, P's stored first | **P's draft** | package-unbound draft | package-unbound draft |
| active rows bound to one package P | P's draft, else the package-unbound one | unchanged | unchanged |
| no active row, only Q's draft / only a package-unbound draft | that draft | unchanged | unchanged |
| no active row, drafts bound to Q and R, none package-unbound | best-effort first row, `version: null` | unchanged (best-effort fallback kept) | `null` |

- `strictDraftReadAddress` (new private helper in `protocol.ts`) maps `packagelessDraftAddress` to a content address: the draft's binding, `null` for the package-unbound draft alone; an `ambiguous` address keeps the package-unbound draft, else the best-effort first match ADR-0048 §3.3 states.
- `servedOverlayRowCandidates` / `findServedOverlayRow` accept `packageId: null` = the package-unbound row only. Every existing caller passes a string or `undefined`, so their candidate order is unchanged.
- **H3, measured:** the draft-overlay preview naming no package (`previewDrafts`) shared the defective address: with Q's draft stored first it served `q` while the fixed strict read served `unbound`. It now takes the same draft address (it carries no `version`). The layered read (`getMetaItemLayered`) reads ACTIVE rows only, so it has no draft door to fix.
- **Rider 6200550012:** `PublishMetaItemRequestSchema.packageId`'s description now carries the "no package-unbound draft" qualifier `SaveMetaItemRequestSchema.packageId`'s has (PR #23706). Description only; `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` regenerated by `check:generated --fix`.
- **No accept set narrows:** no request answered `200` before is refused now; `?package=` still reaches each package's draft. The write, publish and discard addresses are not touched.

## Verification (head `eaa4b0ed`)

- **Negative control on `main` (`9e0945cf4`), in-memory double:** the new `[#23715]` pins, run before the fix: `Tests 2 failed | 4 passed` — `expected 'q' to be 'unbound'` (Q's draft first) and `expected 'p' to be 'unbound'` (two active packages, P's draft first).
- **better-sqlite3 (REST harness):** all three orders (unbound saved first, Q's saved first, both seeded Q's first) were already green on `main`, and stay green: `sys_metadata`'s `(type, name, package_id, bundle_member)` index returns the NULL-bound row first, so on this store content and version agreed by index order alone. These pins are positive pins plus the `If-Match` round trip; the double is the store that diverged.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation restoring `main`'s address logic, the suite imports `./protocol.js` from `src`): `Tests 2 failed | 55 passed (57)` — exactly the two divergence pins; restore proven (`blob == HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: `Test Files 236 passed | 3 skipped`, `Tests 20572 passed | 19 skipped`.
- Draft-door pins from PR #23706 and PR #23654: `protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts` + `sys-metadata-repository.draft-package-inherit.test.ts` `Tests 81 passed`; `meta-draft-head-package-inheritance.test.ts` + `meta-draft-read-door-census.test.ts` `Tests 30 passed` (against a rebuilt `metadata-protocol` dist).
- Typecheck: `metadata-protocol`, `spec`, `rest`, each exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: `All 14 generated artifacts are up to date` after `--fix` regenerated `check:docs` alone.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `eaa4b0ed`: 111 commands; `--ran` with exit codes: `111 derived, 110 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: needs every package built; CI runs it). Two first-pass exit-3 prerequisites were satisfied and re-run to exit 0: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (fetched its pinned fixture commit) and `spec check:skill-examples` (built `client-react`).

- The list's draft-preview merge (`mergePackageAwareOverlay`, the list's other served-row reader) was not measured for the `[package-unbound, Q]` shape; it carries no per-item `version`.
- `main` moved three commits after the branch point (rest analytics refactor, objectql, organizations); none touches this diff's files or behaviour, and GitHub reports no conflict, so `main` was not merged in.
